summary: Material Week 3 injury change: reliable NFL Network reporting after Jaxson Dart's MRI says the left-knee injury is worse than initially believed, with an extended absence expected and a possible season-ending outcome, although the Giants have not announced a final diagnosis or timetable. Treat any stale Dart Week 3 player-prop market as AVOID and rebuild Giants skill-player assumptions around Jameis Winston if/when the team confirms him as starter. Separately, the official Tuesday ATL-GB participation report is now available: Jayden Reed and guards Aaron Banks and Zach Bako-Bewele are DNP, Donovan Jennings improved to limited, while Michael Penix Jr., Tua Tagovailoa, Jawaan Taylor and Brian Robinson are full participants for Atlanta. Current DraftKings ATL-GB milestones remain insufficient for a price-adjusted BET: Tucker Kraft 40+ receiving has worsened to -157, Love 230+ passing is -113 amid receiver/OL uncertainty, and other visible milestones either carry heavy juice or lack a robust independent probability edge. No Week 3 ticket is recommended at this checkpoint.

materialNews.claim: NFL Network reporting says Dart's post-MRI knee diagnosis is worse than first believed, an extended absence is expected, and missing the rest of the season is possible. Giants coach John Harbaugh said evaluations are ongoing and no final decision has been made.
materialNews.decisionImpact: AVOID stale Dart Week 3 props; reset Giants passing/receiving/rushing projections once the starting quarterback is officially confirmed.

materialNews.decisionImpact: Do not promote Green Bay passing overs from Terrell's absence alone while Reed and multiple offensive linemen remain uncertain. Atlanta offensive availability is improving, but no current player prop clears PRIME's price threshold from that fact alone.

marketSnapshots.reason: The same 40+ threshold became seven cents more expensive since 15:31 ET and now requires a 61.1% raw hit rate. No independent current distribution verifies that probability, and Green Bay's pass-catching/OL health remains unsettled.
The less-juiced milestone is more interesting than 40+ -157, but PRIME lacks a current independent yardage distribution establishing a 4-5 percentage-point edge above the 52.6% break-even rate.

A.J. Terrell's absence improves the matchup, but Jayden Reed and multiple Packers offensive linemen are not practicing fully and public passing projections have been dispersed around the market. A point projection near the threshold is not enough to lay -113.

Penix is a full participant and Atlanta's offensive injury state is improving, but London has only 10 targets and 80 receiving yards through two games and there is no current probability stack supporting 64+ at the -113 break-even threshold.

Golden has produced 95 and 58 receiving yards through two games, but -208 demands roughly a 67.5% raw hit rate and Reed's status can alter target distribution. No current modeled hit probability supports paying that juice.
